raw_response:
I am already old, and there is only me at home, so this year I cannot spread myself too thin. Stevia brings cash, so I will keep most of the land in stevia. But I still want some wheat and maize on part of the land, because grain in hand makes me feel steadier, and if the market for stevia turns bad I still have something. I will not do anything fancy. I will farm the way that has worked nearby: use enough fertilizer so the crop does not look weak, irrigate when the soil turns dry, and hire a little help only for the jobs I cannot finish alone. For wheat, since it is already in the field at the start of the season, I will mainly manage water and one more fertilizer trip. After harvest, I will rush to plant summer maize right away on that same land. Stevia needs more hand work, so I cannot put all 15 mu into it by myself, but it still gives better cash than grain, so I will give it 10 mu and manage it carefully.
